exposure: maternal syphilis treatment initiation time (first trimester/third trimester)
cohort: The study included 4210 syphilis-infected pregnant women who delivered at or after 28 gestational weeks in Jiangxi Province, China, between January 1, 2013, and December 31, 2019.
finding: Maternal syphilis treatment, especially early and adequate treatment, significantly reduces the risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes such as stillbirth, preterm birth, low birth weight, and congenital syphilis.
